untertitel: Run complete operating systems on the NAS – Linux, Windows or a ready-made appliance ISO. Installation runs via the console in the browser.
leer: No VM yet. Put an ISO file into a share and click “New VM” above.
kein_kvm: Hardware virtualization is off – VMs will run very slowly. Please enable “Intel VT-x” or “AMD-V/SVM” in the BIOS.
libvirt_fehlt: The VM service (libvirt) is not responding: {grund}
ausschalten_titel: Like pulling the plug – only if shutting down doesn't work
ausschalten_frage: Force power off VM “{name}”? Unsaved data in the VM will be lost.
loeschen_frage: Permanently delete VM “{name}” including its disk?
cd_erklaerung: ISO file from a share, e.g. for drivers or another installation medium.
name: Name
name_erklaerung: Short name of lowercase letters, digits and -, e.g. allinone.
titel_erklaerung: Optional – shown in addition to the name.
system_erklaerung: So that drivers and defaults match.
windows_hinweis: Windows automatically gets UEFI with Secure Boot and a TPM 2.0 – so Windows 11 installs right away.
iso_erklaerung: ISO files from your shares (up to three folders deep), grouped by share – including plugged-in drives.
iso_keine_gefunden: There is no ISO file in the shares yet – upload one first.
cpu_erklaerung: The NAS has {n} cores; the VM shares them with the NAS.
ram_erklaerung: The NAS has {gesamt}; at least 1 GB stays reserved for the NAS itself.
platte_erklaerung: Only grows up to this size as it is used (thin provisioned).
netz_erklaerung: NAT: the VM can reach the internet but is not directly reachable on the home network. Home network: the VM gets its own address from the router.
firmware_erklaerung: UEFI for current systems, BIOS only for very old ones.
autostart_erklaerung: The VM starts automatically when the NAS boots.
angelegt: VM “{name}” is running – the console is opening.
konsole_verbunden: Connected – click into the screen to type.
konsole_fehler: Connection lost – is the VM still running?
konsole_novnc_fehlt: The console could not be loaded: {fehler}
